testimonials.subtitle: Sample feedback · real usage
testimonials.quote_1: I used to spend 3 hours a day manually cross-posting to 5 platforms. Now I queue once and focus on content.
testimonials.quote_2: Managing 12 account groups used to take 4 operators. Now one is enough — and we get cookie-expiry warnings on time.
testimonials.quote_3: We run 80+ accounts from our studio — sau is the only tool that doesn't choke on logins, captchas, or uploads.

faq.q_1: Is my account safe? Will cookies leak?
faq.a_1: Cookies and login state stay on your local machine. The system collects nothing, uploads nothing, and every publish action runs on your own computer.
faq.q_2: I don't know code — can I use this?
faq.a_2: Yes. QR sign-in to a platform → drop in your video → pick an account group → click publish. Zero code required.
faq.q_3: Which platforms do you support, and what's next?
faq.a_3: Mainline: Douyin, Bilibili, Xiaohongshu, Kuaishou. Beta: WeChat Video, Baijia. Roadmap: TikTok and YouTube.
faq.q_4: What happens when a cookie expires?
faq.a_4: The system continuously polls login state and nudges you 24 hours before expiry — re-scan the QR to refresh. All platforms use standard QR login.
faq.a_5: Everything stays local. Unless you opt-in to cloud backup, your videos never leave your machine.
